subject: Chemistry
title: Coordination Compounds
summary: Coordination compound mein central metal atom/ion ligands (Lewis bases) se coordinate bonds se juda hota hai, jaise [Co(NH₃)₆]Cl₃. Jude hue donor atoms ki sankhya coordination number hai.
Werner's theory: metals ki primary valence (oxidation state, ionisable) aur secondary valence (coordination number, directional, non-ionisable) hoti hai.

Valence bond theory hybridisation se geometry aur magnetic behaviour samjhati hai; crystal field theory d orbitals ki splitting (Δₒ) se colour aur magnetism — strong-field ligands pairing karwaate hain (low spin).
Isomerism (structural: ionisation, linkage, coordination, hydrate; stereo: geometrical, optical) aur IUPAC naming sabse zyada poochhe jaate hain.

formulas.name: Oxidation state of the metal
formulas.formula: charge of complex = metal oxidation state + Σ ligand charges
formulas.mistake: Neutral ligands (NH₃, H₂O, CO, en) 0 dete hain — unhe charge mat do.

formulas.name: Coordination number
formulas.formula: CN = number of donor atoms attached (bidentate en counts 2, EDTA⁴⁻ counts 6)
formulas.mistake: Donor atoms gino, ligands nahi — en jaisa bidentate 2 deta hai.

formulas.name: Spectrochemical series
formulas.formula: I⁻ < Br⁻ < SCN⁻ < Cl⁻ < S²⁻ < F⁻ < OH⁻ < C₂O₄²⁻ < H₂O < NCS⁻ < EDTA⁴⁻ < NH₃ < en < CN⁻ < CO
formulas.mistake: CN⁻ aur CO strong-field (pairing karwaate); halides weak-field — ulta mat lo.

formulas.name: CFT splitting (octahedral)
formulas.formula: t₂g (3 orbitals, −0.4Δₒ each) and e_g (2 orbitals, +0.6Δₒ each)

formulas.name: CFSE
formulas.formula: CFSE = (−0.4 x + 0.6 y) Δₒ (+ pairing energies);  x = t₂g, y = e_g electrons

formulas.name: High spin vs low spin
formulas.formula: Δₒ < P → high spin (weak field);  Δₒ > P → low spin (strong field)

formulas.name: Tetrahedral splitting
formulas.formula: Δₜ = (4/9) Δₒ;  almost always high spin

formulas.name: VBT hybridisation and geometry
formulas.formula: sp³ tetrahedral;  dsp² square planar;  sp³d² octahedral (outer orbital, high spin);  d²sp³ octahedral (inner orbital, low spin)

formulas.name: Geometrical isomers
formulas.formula: MA₄B₂ (octahedral): 2 (cis, trans);  MA₃B₃: 2 (fac, mer);  MA₂B₂ square planar: 2;  tetrahedral: none

formulas.name: Optical isomers
formulas.formula: [M(AA)₃] (e.g. [Co(en)₃]³⁺): 2 enantiomers;  cis-[M(AA)₂B₂] is optically active, trans is not

formulas.name: Werner's theory
formulas.formula: primary valence = oxidation state (satisfied by anions, ionisable);  secondary valence = CN (fixed geometry)
formulas.when: AgCl precipitation aur conductance data samajhna.

examples.title: Oxidation state
examples.solution: Complex ion ka charge = +2: x + 0 − 1 = +2 → x = +3.

examples.title: Low-spin iron(III)
examples.solution: Fe³⁺ d⁵, CN⁻ strong field → t₂g⁵ (1 unpaired) → μ = √3 ≈ 1.73 BM (d²sp³).

examples.title: High-spin iron(III)
examples.solution: F⁻ weak field → t₂g³e_g² (5 unpaired) → μ = √35 ≈ 5.92 BM (sp³d²).

examples.title: [Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺ ka CFSE
examples.problem: Co³⁺ d⁶; NH₃ use low spin banata hai. CFSE (pairing energy ignore)?

examples.title: Stereoisomers ginna
examples.solution: trans (optically inactive) + cis (enantiomers ka ek pair) = 3.

examples.title: Werner ka data
examples.problem: 1 mol CoCl₃·6NH₃ excess AgNO₃ se 3 mol AgCl deta hai. Formula?

examples.title: IUPAC naam
examples.solution: Potassium trioxalatoferrate(III): ligands alphabetically prefixes ke saath, anionic complex -ate par khatam (ferrate), oxidation state Roman numerals mein.

topics.title: Key terms
topics.explain: Ligand: electron pair dene wala ion ya molecule (monodentate NH₃, Cl⁻; bidentate en, C₂O₄²⁻; polydentate EDTA⁴⁻). Ambidentate ligands do alag atoms se judte hain (NO₂⁻/ONO⁻, SCN⁻/NCS⁻). Chelate: polydentate ligand se bani ring — extra stable (chelate effect).

topics.title: IUPAC naming rules
topics.explain: Cation pehle, anion baad mein. Bracket ke andar: ligands alphabetical order mein (di/tri prefixes ignore), phir metal aur Roman numerals mein oxidation state. Anionic ligands -o par (chlorido, cyanido, oxalato); neutral: aqua, ammine, carbonyl. Anionic complexes -ate naam (ferrate, cuprate, argentate, aurate, plumbate).

topics.title: Structural isomerism
topics.explain: Ionisation: [Co(NH₃)₅Br]SO₄ vs [Co(NH₃)₅SO₄]Br. Linkage: M–NO₂ vs M–ONO. Coordination: cationic aur anionic complexes ke beech ligands ka exchange. Hydrate (solvate): [Cr(H₂O)₆]Cl₃ (violet) vs [Cr(H₂O)₅Cl]Cl₂·H₂O (green).

topics.title: Colour of complexes
topics.explain: Ek khaas energy (= Δ) ki light electron ko t₂g se e_g tak uthaati hai; hum complementary colour dekhte hain. [Ti(H₂O)₆]³⁺ violet. Ligands na hon (anhydrous CuSO₄) to splitting nahi, isliye safed.

topics.title: Limitations of VBT and CFT
topics.explain: VBT colour ya ligands ki strength nahi samjhati. CFT ligands ko point charges maanti hai aur neutral CO strong ligand kyun hai nahi samjha sakti — iske liye metal–ligand π back-bonding chahiye (metal carbonyls jaise Ni(CO)₄, Fe(CO)₅).

topics.title: Importance and applications
topics.explain: Haemoglobin (Fe), chlorophyll (Mg), vitamin B₁₂ (Co) coordination compounds hain. EDTA paani ki hardness naapne aur lead poisoning ke ilaaj mein; cis-platin anticancer drug; complexes metallurgy (CN⁻ se gold extraction) aur analysis (dimethylglyoxime se Ni²⁺) mein.

ratta: Oxidation state from charge balance; CN = donor atoms.
Strong field: CN⁻, CO, en, NH₃;  weak: I⁻, Br⁻, Cl⁻, F⁻.
d²sp³ inner, low spin;  sp³d² outer, high spin;  dsp² square planar.
